Every tiered block and item (conduits, cells, tanks, cylinders and the portables) is made from its tier's alloy. All four are smelted in the Arcforge Furnace, from a metal, one or two additives and coal coke.
# Recipes (each also gives slag)
- Wrought: 2 iron + 1 gold + 1 coke, from 1,200°C.
- Tempered: 2 steel + 2 copper + 1 coke, from 1,300°C.
- Hardened: 2 steel + 2 amethyst shards + 1 nickel plate + 2 coke, from 1,400°C.
- Arcforged: 2 Hardened Alloy + 2 Carbon Fiber + 1 Arcite-Tungsten Composite + 2 coke, from 1,500°C. Carbon Fiber comes from the Distillation Array's pitch; the composite is a tungsten plate and two arcite crystals.
Each smelt makes two ingots. The higher tiers need the furnace hotter; it keeps heating while it burns coke, up to 1,600°C.
Tempered Alloy also goes into the machine array casings.
